test_title: PYST 50: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six students Meera, Jigyasa, Tarun, Naina, Shambhavi and Avni are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Shambhavi is an immediate neighbour of both Jigyasa and Avni. Tarun is sitting third to the left of Jigyasa. Meera is sitting second to the right of Avni.

Who is sitting third to the right of Meera?
solution:
Given: Six students Meera, Jigyasa, Tarun, Naina, Shambhavi and Avni are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). 

1) Tarun is sitting third to the left of Jigyasa.

2) Shambhavi is an immediate neighbour of both Jigyasa and Avni. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f627068ab43ca1a8bbd76bd7ce97977ba3c42235003360aa659393e367bc8af.png] 

3) Meera is sitting second to the right of Avni.

And, Naina will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d0818f1e2178de2e94d3f25f1a3ffad192a80f0279d707a039b52efa26cfe47.png] 

So, '**Shambhavi**' is sitting third to the right of Meera.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
